a workshop.
EK W
Good morning. Welcome to the City Water Department's
new-employee workshop. ® This morning, I'll be
demonstrating the use of our specialized apparatus to test
water for sodium and other mineral components. Although
the workshop will take place here in our laboratory,
I'll also demonstrate how the equipment can test water
at a project site. It is surprisingly simple to use, which is
a big advantage in the field. At the end of the session,
you'll receive a certificate of completion to show that you're
qualified in the use of the equipment.
